texts.en:
The colonists have all been transferred to the new £colony_ship£ Colony Ship, and her captain reports all systems go. A momentous day, for sure!

There are different ways to establish a £colony£ Colony.

To Colonize a £planet£ Planet on the Galaxy Map;

£dot_green£ Click a colonizable Planet
£dot_green£ Click on the Colonize button

                            £colonizable£

Once the colonists have disembarked, they will take a few years to fully establish the colony.
